course_name: 移動端應用程式設計與製作
outline:
本課程介紹移動應用程式的設計與開發，涵蓋移動端使用者介面和使用者體驗設計原則，並討論平台特定的挑戰和最佳實踐。課程包括注重疊待開發、前端設計和測試的實作專案，旨在幫助學生開發和部署功能完整的移動應用程式。
This course introduces the design and development of mobile applications, covering the principles of mobile user interface and user experience design, while discussing platform-specific challenges and best practices. The course includes hands-on projects that focus on iterative development, front-end design, and testing, aiming to help students develop and deploy fully functional mobile applications.
schedule:
Week 1: Course Introduction
Week 2: Introduction to Interface, Interaction, and Interdisciplinary
Week 3: Setting Up the Development Environment
Week 4: Features and Advantages of Applications
Week 5: Introduction to Software Engineering
Week 6: Interface Design and Navigation Structure
Week 7: Concept and Application of Gamification
Week 8: Introduction to Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality
Week 9: Midterm Presentation and Project Discussion
Week 10: Selection and Editing of Multimedia Content
Week 11: Organization and Presentation of Content
Week 12: Design of Interactive Elements
Week 13: Responsive Design and Cross-Platform Adaptability
Week 14: Introduction to Backend Development and Server-Side Technologies
Week 15: Using Databases for Storing and Managing Application Data
Week 16: Pre-Launch Testing and Preparation for App Deployment
Week 17: Optimization Based on App Performance and User Feedback
Week 18: Final Project Presentation
assessment:
Midterm report: 30%
Final report: 50%
Attendance and performance: 20%
